package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- store/store.go --
package store

type DB struct{ Addr string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "primary"} }

//fabrik:provider name=replica
func NewReplicaDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "replica"} }

type Reporting struct{ DB *DB }

//fabrik:inject db name=replica
//fabrik:provider
func NewReporting(db *DB) *Reporting { return &Reporting{DB: db} }

type Pool struct{}

//fabrik:provider name=warm
func NewWarmPool() *Pool { return &Pool{} }

type Warmer struct{ P *Pool }

//fabrik:inject p name=warm
//fabrik:provider
func NewWarmer(p *Pool) *Warmer { return &Warmer{P: p} }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"app/store"
)

//fabrik:inject Replica name=replica
type API struct {
	DB        *store.DB
	Replica   *store.DB
	Reporting *store.Reporting
}

//fabrik:http GET /api
func (a *API) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/store"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		storeDB := store.NewDB()
		storeDBReplica := store.NewReplicaDB()
		storeReporting := store.NewReporting(storeDBReplica)
		webAPI := &web.API{
			DB:        storeDB,
			Replica:   storeDBReplica,
			Reporting: storeReporting,
		}

		r := router.New()

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/api", webAPI.Get)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
